# netbox_table_config (Data Source)

Retrieves a single table config from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_table_config" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "table_config_id" {
  value = data.netbox_table_config.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the table config.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (List of String) The columns of the table config.
- `created` (String) The created of the table config.
- `description` (String) A description of the table config.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the table config.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the table config.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the table config.
- `ordering` (List of String) The ordering of the table config.
- `shared` (Boolean) The shared of the table config.
- `table` (String) The table of the table config.
- `user` (Number) The user of the table config.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the table config.
